entries.title: What are your branch opening hours?
entries.content: Branches are open 08:30 to 16:00, Monday to Friday.

entries.title: Are branches open on Saturday?
entries.content: Selected branches are open on Saturday from 09:00 to 12:00. Check the branch locator in the app.

entries.title: What do I need to open a savings account?
entries.content: Bring your Ghana Card, proof of address such as a recent utility bill, and a passport photo to any branch.

entries.title: What is the SWIFT code?
entries.content: Use the SWIFT code shown on your account confirmation letter or in the app under Account details.

entries.title: How do I reset my app PIN?
entries.content: On the login screen tap Forgot PIN and follow the steps. You will need your registered phone number. Never share your PIN or one-time codes with anyone.

entries.title: How do I register for online banking?
entries.content: Download the app, tap Register, and follow the steps using your account number and registered phone number.

entries.title: What is the fee for a transfer to another bank?
entries.content: Transfers to other banks through the app cost GHS 5 per transfer.

entries.title: How much is a replacement debit card?
entries.content: A replacement debit card costs GHS 30 and is ready for collection at your branch within 5 working days.

entries.title: What is the contact centre number?
entries.content: Call the contact centre on the number printed on the back of your card, available 24 hours a day.
